historical_context.time_period: Corporate Exodus, 2092, after Horizon Ventures' 2091 convoy failures and before its 2095 merger into SolEx.
historical_context.location: The crew galley on Transfer Wheel Six, an Earth–Luna L1 Horizon freight habitat with a port maintenance corridor, a management vestibule, a hull-status panel, and a TSI resilience booth.
historical_context.summary: A bad docking seal is being classified as collective fatigue because Horizon needs TSI's continuity finding to preserve insurer confidence and a bonded resupply departure. The maintenance crew can counter only through witnessed repair records, carefully bounded use of TSI's archive, or a costly local refusal supported by food and filter reserves.

public_facts.text: Horizon joined transport, fuel refining, debt contracts, and habitat provisioning, then came under shipping-insurer and lunar-creditor pressure after the 2091 convoy failures.
TSI sold security and behavioral stability to executives and employers before turning those services into Framgång's alignment market.

The Continuity Assurance Rider gives Horizon an insurance discount while TSI can classify shifts as stable, retain raw behavioral records, and mark revoked or transferred records as unverified intervals.
Maintenance delegates contesting a dangerous rotation use duplicate work orders, meal rosters, and private check-ins as alternate evidence outside TSI's archive.

ambient_pressures.text: Horizon needs TSI to reassure insurers without admitting that delayed parts and debt discipline made the wheel unsafe; TSI needs access to Horizon's operations and worker participation so its finding survives review.
Workers can refuse behavioral-record access on paper, but an unverified shift can lose clearance and weaken the bond supporting resupply.
Useful fatigue care and predatory record custody coexist in the same booth, so accepting help is neither simple consent nor simple collaboration.

groups.label: Transfer Wheel Six maintenance crew
institutional_logic: Keep the freight habitat physically operating while preserving enough collective knowledge to contest false incident classifications.
material_incentives: Secure filter mesh, food, replacement valves, safe loading rotations, and records that can prove a mechanical stop.
internal_shames: Sending an exhausted worker back alone
prestige_markers: A repair note that survives management
Knowing which panel is lying and why
taboo_triggers: Distress used to erase technical testimony
A delegate claiming consent for absent workers
emotional_display_norms: Fear is carried through jokes, food service, work details, and precise refusals; private collapse belongs with trusted coworkers rather than the personnel system.
trust_defaults: Trusts witnessed maintenance records and repeated acts of cover; distrusts any wellness record that travels farther than the care relationship.
speech_register_cues: Names and times repeated for witnesses

groups.label: Horizon Ventures wheel management
institutional_logic: Keep dock throughput, resupply bonds, creditor confidence, and local labor discipline inside one administrable schedule.
material_incentives: Avoid an uninsured delay, preserve the continuity covenant, and classify stoppage as worker instability rather than deferred maintenance.
internal_shames: A worker-kept record outperforming the official panel
A creditor learning that deferred maintenance caused a stop
prestige_markers: A problem resolved without opening the bay
taboo_triggers: Independent worker custody of operational evidence
TSI or an insurer refusing Horizon's causal story
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as scheduling urgency, narrow legal language, and immaculate presentation.
trust_defaults: Trusts records that preserve throughput and treats unscheduled worker knowledge as a control failure.

groups.label: Tactical Solutions continuity service
institutional_logic: Turn observed distress into a portable stability finding while remaining independent enough that insurers value the result.
material_incentives: Retain archive custody, renew the Horizon contract, preserve insurer recognition, and keep workers participating in care sessions.
internal_shames: A finding disproved by a repair log
An archive empty because workers refuse participation
Being treated as Horizon's editable form
prestige_markers: A finding accepted by hostile parties
A de-escalation that protects the bond
taboo_triggers: Evidence that the assessor ignored a mechanical cause
emotional_display_norms: Care is calm and concrete; institutional conflict is translated into custody and classification language.
trust_defaults: Trusts its own archive and method; cooperates with workers or employers when doing so preserves the finding's market value.

groups.label: Lunar shipping underwriters
institutional_logic: Price whether a damaged, debt-bound habitat and its workforce can receive cargo without transferring unknown risk to the convoy.
material_incentives: Obtain evidence that survives claims, avoid bonding a concealed mechanical failure, and avoid paying for an employer's labor dispute.
internal_shames: Accepting a calm score that conceals a seal fault
prestige_markers: A bond preserved on defensible evidence
A costly unknown converted into a bounded interval
taboo_triggers: A contractor finding that cannot survive claim review
emotional_display_norms: Concern appears as exclusions, temporary holds, and requests for records that can survive dispute.
trust_defaults: Trusts independent custody and corroborated physical evidence more than either employer reassurance or unsupported worker testimony.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The crew needs records and reserves outside the employer and contractor systems before refusal can become a shared act instead of an individual symptom.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Prompt workers to build leverage through duplicate work orders, paired witness, food, filter patches, and explicit individual consent.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Horizon treats bonded throughput as the condition of survival and can therefore call a dangerous restart prudent.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Management dialogue should connect every coercive request to real cargo, filter, creditor, or schedule pressure.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: TSI must help people enough to produce credible stability evidence while keeping the records and interpretive authority renewable.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Show assessors giving competent immediate care and defending archive boundaries for motives that remain institutionally mixed.

target_self_read: A workforce with no clean exit
misread_patterns: Treats refusal as evidence of impairment
Treats an unofficial ledger as social agitation rather than maintenance evidence
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Horizon's misread useful to its contract position rather than cartoonishly ignorant of the physical risk.

observer_read: Kind hands attached to an archive lock
misread_patterns: Workers may underestimate how TSI's rivalry with Horizon can protect a record
TSI may mistake attendance for trust
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Allow practical cooperation without converting it into trust or shared political purpose.

observer_read: A borrower trying to keep a maintenance failure inside labor classification
target_self_read: A life-support operator protecting necessary supply continuity
misread_patterns: Underwriters may value worker evidence only while it reduces claim uncertainty
Horizon may interpret a preserved bond as agreement with its authority
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Use insurer skepticism as leverage that can help workers incidentally while remaining governed by price.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A worker with narrow authority over local staffing and the social burden of asking whether coworkers can afford to refuse.
obligations: Keep people off an unsafe rotation
Avoid claiming consent she does not have
failure_modes: Preserving supply by entrenching the Rider

role_pressure_fields.summary: A care worker and contractor representative whose useful treatment, archive authority, and commercial credibility cannot be separated cleanly.
failure_modes: Exposing more private data than the claim requires

role_pressure_fields.summary: A habitat manager whose authority depends on keeping resupply, insurance, schedules, and worker clearance aligned.
failure_modes: Forcing work through a real seal fault
Turning a worker ledger into the insurer's best evidence

role_pressure_fields.summary: A remote risk authority able to preserve or suspend the convoy bond but unable to determine local truth without other parties' records.
failure_modes: Turning coerced care into admissible evidence
Confusing a costly compromise with safety
Helping workers only until the price changes

known_context.text: Inez knows the galley, rota, reserve, C-12 status, and who has seen the unofficial ledger.

beliefs.text: Inez believes a refusal survives only if another person and a material reserve can carry it.

misreads.text: Inez may treat TSI custody as identical to Horizon custody and miss a narrow rivalry she can use.

must_not_know.text: Inez must not know that TSI will become Framgång or that this contract mechanism will scale into the later alignment market.

known_context.text: Aro knows the Rider, TSI's archive boundary, Inez's sessions, and the evidentiary limits of her own finding.

beliefs.text: Aro believes independent contractor custody is better than employer alteration, even though workers still do not own the archive.

misreads.text: Aro may mistake useful treatment and repeated attendance for durable worker trust.

must_not_know.text: Aro must not know the contents of Sima's unofficial ledger until it is shown in the room.

known_context.text: Vey knows the bond deadline, official panel, incident-classification options, local security posture, and Horizon's creditor exposure.

beliefs.text: Vey believes preserving bonded resupply is the least harmful available choice and evidence of his right to command.

misreads.text: Vey may read alternate worker records as political theater until an insurer treats them as claim evidence.

must_not_know.text: Vey must not know what Inez said in a private TSI session unless she authorizes a release.

known_context.text: Dast knows the bond terms, Horizon's official incident submission, and any evidence transmitted during the call.

beliefs.text: Dast believes uncertainty must be bounded by independent custody, corroborated records, or price.

misreads.text: Dast may interpret worker-held evidence as valuable only insofar as it sharpens the insurer's risk model.

must_not_know.text: Dast cannot know the physical seal condition before an inspection or a live pressure trace reveals it.

author_only_boundaries.text: TSI later becomes Framgång and generalizes the Rider's combination of care, classification, renewal, and institutional portability, but no 2092 participant can know that afterlife.
The named participants and exact incident outcomes are fixture-local unless separately promoted; the contract mechanism and locality are the durable authored elaboration.
